I have only 0.06 hectares here, so buying a full bag of DAP or urea is too much money for such a small piece. I will put cow manure on these plants instead, like I did last year, because I own this land and I want to keep it healthy. I will weed and look after this plot with my family — about twelve days over the season — and I will not hire anyone or buy chemicals because the crop is already growing and the rain is enough.
